disclosures: Rubric changed from v1 to v2: assessment moved to table-stakes and contract consistency, green gates, reproducibility, and source verifiability were added.
The 100% to 57% coverage change is mostly a harder and better-grounded bar, not a six-point product regression.
Standard-mode discovery used multiple query families; final rounds produced only niche or cross-cluster references, not a stronger same-cluster peer.
